channel.title: Helmet Belgian Model 49 FN - Commentaires
channel.description:
The first helmet I want to introduce is a Belgian Model 49 FN
The second Belgium Model 49FN Army (2)
This ABL helmet from 1952 manufactured by the company X.B. Xavier Buisset from Vilvoorde. AB = Armee Belge (French) BL = Belgisch Leger (Dutch) both mean Belgian Armee
